annotation.reasoning_summary: The dataset represents residential building blocks ('woonblokken') which are identifiable real-world objects. Although they have numeric attributes like percentages, they are the primary entities being mapped, not a statistical reporting unit or a mere patch of influence.

The map layer represents archaeological sites and finds (cesspits, artifacts) as discrete points at specific locations. These are identifiable real-world objects/locations, fitting the definition of ObjectDS.
